description: This file defines the ChronometerDemo class, an Android Activity demonstrating the use of the Chronometer widget with controls to start, stop, reset, and format the timer.

classes.name: ChronometerDemo
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating how to control a Chronometer widget with buttons for start, stop, reset, and formatting.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and assigns click listeners to control the Chronometer.

methods.name: mStartListener
methods.description: Listener to start the Chronometer when the start button is clicked.

methods.name: mStopListener
methods.description: Listener to stop the Chronometer when the stop button is clicked.

methods.name: mResetListener
methods.description: Listener to reset the Chronometer's base time.

methods.name: mSetFormatListener
methods.description: Listener to set a formatted string for the Chronometer.

methods.name: mClearFormatListener
methods.description: Listener to clear any format string on the Chronometer.
